# House style (fixture pack)

[Pack example] A short house style for the Signal test pack. Every rule here is proposed until a named native
editor signs it; the slice treats it as data only.

## Voice

- Warm, playful and family-friendly; Tehrani colloquial (shekaste) for narration and captions.
- Address the viewer as «تو», never «شما».
- Never mock an elder or a tradition; the joke is always on the lead.

## Words

- Small numbers as words in captions («سه تا», not «۳ تا»).
- Ezafe after a silent heh as «ه‌ی» (ZWNJ + yeh).
- The brand name is written only as the glossary spells it.

## Claims

- No "free", no ranking, no level counts.
